posts.title: REST API Development with Qt 6
posts.description: This post describes an experiment using Qt 6.7’s REST APIs to explore Stripe’s payment model, and what I learned building a small desktop developer tool. Recent Qt releases have included several conveniences for developing clients of remote REST APIs. I recently tried it out with the Stripe payments REST API to get to grips with […]

posts.title: Grantlee version 5.3.1 now available
posts.description: I’ve just made a new 5.3.1 release of Grantlee. The 5.3.0 release had some build issues with Qt 6 which should now be resolved with version 5.3.1. Unlike previous releases, this release will not appear on http://www.grantlee.org/downloads/. I’ll be turning off grantlee.org soon.
